name: tool-skills
description: Local CLI tool skills for agent workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Skill routing notes for local CLI tools.
interface.longDescription: A personal local plugin for CLI-first tool workflows. Each bundled skill explains when to use a local command-line tool, how to verify it, and when to fall back to the host agent's native file and shell tools.
defaultPrompt: Use the right local CLI tool skill for this task.

Use tool-fast-context as the first semantic locator for unknown local code entrypoints. Search requires authorization because it sends repository context to Windsurf, and every candidate must be verified locally.

Use tool-codesearch as the local-only semantic-search fallback when tool-fast-context is unavailable, external repository transmission is not authorized, or CLI search fails; keep new and incremental codesearch index work in the background.
Use the tool-officecli skill first for reading, inspecting, or extracting Excel files, and for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint workflows that need bounded CLI output.
